_capture.provenance: synthetic — declared, never presented as a recording (GOR-245 specs.md § 6.14(2)). No recording exists and none can be made: the only available test citizen has no paid transactions (`applications total 0`, `balance_lak 0`, measured 2026-08-14), and § 4.4 forbids `POST /applications/:id/pay` and `POST /applications/` against ANY host — manufacturing a case so there is something to pay for is the specific loophole that rule exists to close.
_capture.credential: none — no citizen token was obtained or seeded (§ 4.4; security-review.md item 6)
_capture.field_discipline: Rows shaped against `types.ts:524-540` (`Transaction`) only. `service_name` and `method_label` are `Bilingual`; `note` is a plain `String` per § 5.2 ruling 1 (Finding J) — a row here parsed as `Bilingual` would throw, so this fixture is also what proves that ruling was implemented rather than asserted.
_capture.synthetic_values: Receipt numbers carry an explicit `-TEST-` infix and the payer is the reserved `Test Citizen`; no real receipt number, account number, UIN or name appears (§ 7.9 item 4/5).
